rca_of_issue:
ROOT CAUSE: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) Policy Violation

REPRODUCTION STEPS:
1. Open https://admiring-wiles-10.preview.emergentagent.com
2. Skip onboarding to reach home screen
3. Observe: Home screen is blank (only bottom tabs visible)
4. Open browser console: See error 'Access to fetch at https://bharatpansari.com/wp-json/bp-app/v1/home from origin https://admiring-wiles-10.preview.emergentagent.com has been blocked by CORS policy'
5. Navigate to Categories tab: Shows error 'Unable to connect'
6. Try search: Returns 'No results found' (API call failed)

TECHNICAL DETAILS:
- Browser makes preflight OPTIONS request to WordPress API
- WordPress server returns non-200 status for OPTIONS request
- Browser blocks actual GET request due to failed preflight
- All fetch() calls from frontend to bharatpansari.com fail

MITIGATION OPTIONS:
1. RECOMMENDED: Create FastAPI proxy endpoints in /app/backend/server.py:
   - Add routes: /api/wp-proxy/home, /api/wp-proxy/categories, etc.
   - Backend makes server-side requests to bharatpansari.com (no CORS)
   - Frontend calls /api/wp-proxy/* instead of direct WordPress URLs
   - Update Config.API_BASE_URL to use backend proxy

2. ALTERNATIVE: Configure WordPress to add CORS headers:
   - Add to .htaccess or WordPress plugin
   - Headers needed: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, OPTIONS, Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type
   - Requires WordPress admin access

3. TEMPORARY: Use CORS proxy service (not recommended for production)

IMPACT: Complete blocker for Phase 1A - no real API data can be loaded until CORS is resolved.
